body:
I was an extremely heavy user of MANY E's, speed, acid and just about anything else I could get my little mitts on through the 90's and early 00's and had some of the best times of my life. But the last time I went raving was 2008.
So I decided it's time for another blow out as I've just been offered some Mandy and am very eager to try it in it's 'natural' form, having only taken pills in the past.  But on doing further research, I've found repeated references to the fact that it may not do  much as I am taking Prozac (I take 20-40mg of Fluoxetine daily), which will inhibit the re-uptake of the Serotonin released by the MDMA.
I was on various SSRI's when I used to go clubbing and lost the empathic effects of the Ecstasy but I just put that down to over-use and 'loss of magic'. Because I was seriously 'bang at it' for so many years.
